title: events: fix logNeedsRotation to measure content size in bytes instead of runes
body:
<!-- Thanks for sending a pull request! -->
## Fixed
#29414 
## Summary
Measure event content size using byte length (`len(content) + 1` including the trailing newline) instead of rune count (`len([]rune(content))`). 

Using rune count caused the size of events with multi-byte UTF-8 characters to be underestimated, allowing the log file to grow past `events_logfile_max_size`.
